description: When onDestroyRemoveEmails=true, the destroy loop issues query_objects + get_objects to find emails in the mailbox, then calls destroy_object or update_object for each email individually. N=1000 emails in a mailbox = 1002 backend calls. There is no batch destroy or batch update path in the MailBackend trait. The trait would need batch operations to fix this, which is a larger design change. Worth flagging because this is the hot path when a user deletes a folder with thousands of messages.
title: Mailbox/set email cascade: 1 query + 1 fetch + N individual destroys/updates per mailbox
